method.intervals: Actual foreground requestAnimationFrame intervals, including browser/GPU draw completion; durations measure synchronous renderer work.
method.denseFixture: scripts/stage7/dense-world-capacity.ts crowded settings, seed 1511506142, ordinary production addon and managed generation-one checkpoint. Physics, sensors, brains, food and deaths stay enabled. Small Dense graph intentionally stresses geometry, not large-network inference.
method.ordinaryFixture: Fresh default Rust startup, seed 1511506142, six calculation workers, no reset/settings overrides. Captured ordinary frame has 43 living snakes, 448 body points and 3506 pellets.
method.serverPreparation: Each replay starts one loopback production server and calls observe(port, boundedWallSeconds, 360, true), then closes it in finally. Separate real spectator socket audits every complete body frame. Ordinary startup closes after 45 seconds.
